activity_summary: At home you settled it for yourself and not for the book. Your legs say one day. Two Errors in a day is a better tale than a clerk's slip. You left the other two accounts standing where they were.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: His book, not amended. Not in the room.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: His oath, left as it is. Not in the room.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: His cold, left as it is. Not in the room.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in My legs say one day

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: My legs say one day. Let it stand. Two Errors in a day is a better tale than a clerk's slip.
